routeHint: Green endpoint: attached. Blue endpoint: free. White handles shape the curve; double-click one to remove it.
connectorAddedAtCenter: {label} added at the center of the board.
waypointsAdded: {count} curve point(s). Move the blue handle.
boardCleared: Board cleared. You can undo this action.
boardReadyToSave: Board is ready to be saved.
helpIntro: The essential gestures and shortcuts for building a board quickly.
helpBasicsSelect: Tap an item to select it, then drag it to move it.
helpBasicsAdd: Tap a tool to add it at the center, or drag it directly onto the board on desktop.
helpBasicsMove: Select a movement to adjust its endpoints and curve handles.
helpBasicsZoom: Pinch, use the zoom controls, or hold Cmd/Ctrl while scrolling. A normal wheel gesture keeps scrolling the page. Drag an empty area while zoomed to move around the board.
